title: Write operator configuration reference
description:
Write docs/operator/configuration.md: complete reference for all TOML config keys in transit/config.example.toml and reader/config.example.toml. Each key: type, default, valid range, effect, example. Covers listen, peers, groups, ipfs, pinning rules, gc, log, admin. Artifact: docs/operator/configuration.md.

Acceptance criteria: every config key from both example files is documented; no undocumented keys exist; examples are valid TOML
